description: The Search Index Management REST API's 'Query a Search Index' and 'Query a Search Index (Scoped)' endpoints both require the Manage tier (cluster.bucket[$BUCKET].fts!manage) - the same tier required to create, update, and delete the index definition itself - while 'Get Document Count for an Index' requires only Statistics and 'Get Index Definition' requires only Read. Running a search query is therefore gated as a write-level operation on this REST surface, unlike the Read-gated equivalent stated on the Web Console / simple-search-rest-api task pages (role:fts-admin OR role:fts-searcher, both Read-tier there). Not asserted as a relation since it may be an intentional asymmetry (query execution costing cluster resources) rather than an error, but the two surfaces disagree on which tier gates 'run a query' and neither page cross-references the other's stance.
